why: Near miss: the dimension step of the toy car. DIMLINEAR's first point snapped to the rear window corner at (18, 28) instead of the bottom-left corner, so the dimension measures 102 mm (group 42) and its text reads 102. The body polyline is 120 long, so 120.0 is in the file as a vertex coordinate (and as the dimension's second point), never as what the dimension shows.

step.title: Dimension the length
step.instructions: On a layer DIMS, add a DIMLINEAR from the bottom-left corner of the body to the bottom-right corner and place it under the car: it should read 120. Save as toy_car.dxf.
